A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Color/Legends|brown]]-skinned, brown-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] was a '''lieutenant''' onboard a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighter]] owned by [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Strange Allies" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was carrying [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] to the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]] when it was intercepted near [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]] by a [[Profit (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|pirate ship]]. The Lieutenant informed the ship's [[Unidentified Klatooinian captain|captain]] that two of the [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] were out and that they had lost the primary [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dool Pundar]], contacted the vessel and ordered its surrender, sending [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s to secure it. Pundar allowed the crew to take refuge in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. As Pundar absconded with their [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the Lieutenant voiced his concerns to the Captain, who ordered him to transmit a distress signal to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He and the crew were later recovered.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lieutenant appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series.
